question: Which algorithms have been developed for analysing CRISPR/Cas9 knockout screens data?

supports.quote: We document the superior performance of HiTSelect using data from both genome-wide RNAi and CRISPR/Cas9 screens.
We propose the Model-based Analysis of Genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 Knockout (MAGeCK) method for prioritizing single-guide RNAs, genes and pathways in genome-scale CRISPR/Cas9 knockout screens.

initial_executor.limitations: Evidence limited to two algorithms (HiTSelect and MAGeCK) explicitly described in the provided text as developed for CRISPR/Cas9 knockout screen analysis; other potential algorithms not mentioned in the supplied evidence segments.
